title: Reid Hoffman picks Incorruptible for his Long Reids 2026 summer reading list
summary: Reid Hoffman — LinkedIn co-founder, Greylock partner, and one of Incorruptible's flagship endorsers — includes the book in his Long Reids newsletter as one of '6 books for your summer list — straight from my network.' The post crosses 362 likes in its first day on his LinkedIn.
blockquote:
A few books I'm reading and recommending this summer, each from a friend, colleague, or collaborator in my network. Think of them less as a ranking, and more as introductions to fascinating ideas, and even more interesting authors.

They span business, history, money, and fiction because the ideas that shape how we should think about the future rarely come from a single field.
attribution_title: Co-founder, LinkedIn; Partner, Greylock; host of Possible and Masters of Scale; Long Reids newsletter
